answer: A canyon wind co-op used to let one trailer mint extra vane licenses and skim the dawn credit on every copy. A crew may now occupy only one surveyed shale terrace, bolt a 1.9-meter vane whose mill serial is photographed when the first measurable zephyr crosses 3.2 m/s, and escrow 13.6 coin plus a 2.8 kg core in a shared cairn for 33 hours. Two wardens rematch the serial, the cairn hash, and four traces 19 minutes apart within 16 meters of the pin. If two licenses share one terrace pin or one core hash, both escrows burn and that terrace stays dark for thirteen epochs.
